objects.taxonomy_description: A croissant is a buttery, flaky pastry characterized by its distinct crescent shape and laminated dough structure.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinctive crescent or horn-like curvature with tapered ends.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior displays visible, thin, flaky layers indicative of laminated dough rather than a smooth or uniform crust.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The surface presents a golden-brown hue resulting from baking, often with slight variations in shading across the layers.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item appears as a baked food product, lacking any biological features such as fur, skin, or limbs associated with living organisms.

objects.taxonomy_description: Large wading bird measuring 120-145 cm in height with wingspan reaching 140-170 cm. Plumage ranges from pale pink to vivid scarlet depending on diet, with darker coloration on wings and tail. Neck is extremely elongated and S-curved, comprising approximately one-third of total body length. Bill is distinctive with downward-curving shape, deep black at tip transitioning to pale pink at base, adapted for filter-feeding. Legs are exceptionally long and bright pink to red with webbed feet. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with compact torso contrasting elongated neck and legs. Wings display black primary feathers visible during flight. Flight posture features full neck extension. Juveniles display grey-white plumage developing pink coloration over 2-3 years. Weight ranges 2-4 kg.
